Dev-layer test — be-functional. Existing coverage: ListLeadTechnicianCandidatesTest.php:59,97; DbalBoardTechnicianFetcherTest.php:53; WorkOrderBoardAssemblerTest.php:58

Preconditions

  • Needs: 2 users · 1 browser · about 25 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011). A desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  • The case is run as [User-B]: a user who has never reordered the technician groups (the order is saved per user). A newly created user is safest: Role Admin (holds Work orders > View), Time Clock off, at this location, with an email you can open.
  • [User-A]: an Owner/Admin user who creates the data (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  • One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location.
  • Five technicians at this location, created in this order: "Aaron Zed", "Aaron Baker", "Brenda Martinez", "Chris Lee" (first), then a second "Chris Lee" (second, different email). These five names are the ones the expected results use. A person only counts as a technician here when the staff member is active (not deactivated), Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Name Order" (used by this case only), with one contact and one asset, so this case's work orders are kept apart from every other work order at the location.
  • Five Approved work orders for that customer, one led by each of the five technicians: [WO-1] led by the first Chris Lee and [WO-2] led by the second Chris Lee, so you can tell the two apart.
  • Nobody is pinned by [User-B].

Setup

  1. Sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page (you appear as "Admin ShopView"). Check the location in the top bar next to the bell; to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location.
  2. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff > New Staff Member > First Name and Last Name, an email you can open, Role "Admin", at least one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock off > Save & Close. Accept the invitation from that email and set a password. Record this user as [User-B].
  3. Top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Name Order" > Save (if it already exists, open it instead). On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, TRK-118) > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  4. Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Name Order" and its asset > Save. The work order opens on its Lines tab with the New Line form open: in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; the build offers only ready-made lines), turn Line Approved on > Save & Close; the work order becomes Approved. Repeat for five work orders in all. Record one number as [WO-1] (the expected results call it "S1-801") and another as [WO-2] (the expected results call it "S1-802") (numbers on this site look like "S10043-17581").
  5. Settings > Staff > New Staff Member, in this order: "Aaron Zed", then "Aaron Baker", then "Brenda Martinez", then "Chris Lee" (first) — each with an Email, Role "Technician", at least one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close.
  6. Set the leads: on an Approved work order pick the technician in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page; it saves at once. (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Assign lead technician (an older screen shows Reassign lead technician) > click the technician (if the window still shows a Reassign button, click it).) Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned. Here: one of the three other work orders each for Aaron Zed, Aaron Baker and Brenda Martinez; [WO-1] = Chris Lee (only one Chris Lee exists at this point).
  7. Settings > Staff > New Staff Member > the second "Chris Lee" (a different email), Role "Technician", at least one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close.
  8. On [WO-2] pick "Chris Lee" in the Lead Technician dropdown, choosing the Chris Lee entry that does not already lead [WO-1].
  9. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > Search ZZAUTOTEST F2 Name Order > Tech View — five technician groups each hold one work order, and there are two "Chris Lee" groups, one holding [WO-1] and one holding [WO-2]. If [WO-1] and [WO-2] sit in the same Chris Lee group, change the lead on [WO-2] to the other Chris Lee entry.
